optimizations.current_state: Paid Pro Workspace ($14.57 prorated in Oct -> $19-$25/mo full rate) + Standard 2 GB Server ($25/mo) = ~$44-$50/mo
optimizations.recommendation: Downgrade Workspace Plan to Hobby ($0/mo) while keeping the paid Standard 2 GB instance ($25/mo).
optimizations.cost_impact: Saves $19-$25/mo ($228-$300/yr) — cuts upcoming Dec Render bill nearly in half.
optimizations.tradeoff: Zero CPU/RAM loss. Loses multi-user seats, >1 instance autoscaling, and Render native HTTP log retention (already handled by Better Stack Logtail). Re-upgrading takes 15s during a surge.

optimizations.current_state: Free plan active; uncached anonymous GET hits reach Render & Supabase directly
optimizations.recommendation: Keep a permanent 30s-60s Anonymous SSR Cache Rule active (cookie-free GET requests excluding /api/, /auth/, /admin, /contact).
optimizations.cost_impact: $0/mo (shields Render Hobby bandwidth cap and prevents egress overages).
optimizations.tradeoff: ~5-8x faster TTFB in India (<50ms from Mumbai/Chennai POPs vs ~400ms origin) + ~80% lower Render CPU & Supabase reads. Logged-in users bypass cache automatically via user_session_token.
